+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+weekdays = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
+con = duckdb.connect()
+counts = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM crash_date) AS INTEGER) AS weekday_num,
+           COUNT(*) AS crashes
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY weekday_num
+    """,
+    [str(ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet")],
+).fetchdf()
+con.close()
+
+values = pd.DataFrame({"weekday_num": range(1, 8), "weekday": weekdays})
+values = values.merge(counts, on="weekday_num", how="left")
+values["crashes"] = values["crashes"].fillna(0).astype("int64")
+dates = pd.date_range("2013-01-01", "2025-12-31", freq="D")
+date_counts = pd.Series(dates.weekday).value_counts().sort_index()
+values["calendar_dates"] = values["weekday_num"].map(lambda n: int(date_counts[n - 1]))
+values["share_pct"] = values["crashes"] / values["crashes"].sum() * 100
+values["avg_crashes_per_date"] = values["crashes"] / values["calendar_dates"]
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.titlesize": 14, "axes.labelsize": 11})
+
+for option_id, column, ylabel, title, color, precision in [
+    (1, "crashes", "Police-reported crashes", "NYC crashes by weekday, 2013–2025", "#2f6690", 0),
+    (2, "avg_crashes_per_date", "Average crashes per calendar date", "Average NYC crashes per weekday date, 2013–2025", "#3a7d44", 1),
+]:
+    values.to_csv(OUT / f"values_{option_id}.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+    bars = ax.bar(values["weekday"], values[column], color=color, width=0.72)
+    ax.set_title(title, pad=14)
+    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
+    ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
+    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=20)
+    for bar, value in zip(bars, values[column]):
+        label = f"{value:,.0f}" if precision == 0 else f"{value:,.1f}"
+        ax.annotate(label, (bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height()),
+                    xytext=(0, 4), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
+    fig.tight_layout()
+    fig.savefig(OUT / f"option_{option_id}.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+print(values.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
